statement: Two independent actual global quotient partitions with metabelian intrinsic target images force the group generated by the actual based source lifts to be closed, simply connected and exponential in its homeomorphism-group topology. The precise list is the translation plane, the positive affine line group, the diagonal real-weight semidirect products R^2 by R with nonzero weight pair, and the product of two positive affine line groups. Their exponential contractions extend to entire orbit closures, satisfy every actual global quotient equation, are natural under the original operators, and paste with the prescribed C53 region over any finite collection, without compact operator quotient assumptions.
depends_on: C29 based circle covering and winding; C37 actual metabelian line/circle classification; C42-C45 global quotient maps, product topology and pair-coordinate domains; C49 Baire transitivity and closed Polish action quotient; C52 actual target-lift comparison; C53 global quotient family and prescribed exponential region; Yamabe's analytic-subgroup theorem followed by the explicit transitive Lie-algebra classification and separate induced-topology proof
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), infinite-operator zero-level comparison; actual noncocompact two-quotient Lie reductions
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Yamabe's theorem gives only the analytic subgroup initially. The proof then classifies its transitive Lie algebra, writes its unique connected subgroup explicitly, and proves that this subgroup is closed with the actual induced homeomorphism-group topology.
notes: The half-plane domain gives the full positive affine group, with the exact equivariant source change (x,y) -> (x,log(y-x)); the band domain is excluded by its commuting unit translation and source transitivity. In the full-plane domain, the Lie algebra is analyzed by its projection S to the two log-scale coordinates and its translation kernel W. A proper W with dim S=2 forces a preserved affine coordinate line. For dim S=1 and dim W=1, transitivity requires zero scale and nonzero translation in the complementary coordinate, giving the simply transitive affine model. The other cases are all translations, the diagonal-weight groups including opposite or zero weights, and the full affine product. The positive function sigma(z)=integral_0^1 exp(rz) dr gives all displayed exponential and logarithm formulas, including zero weights. The exact Polish group E_O acts on the closure and on every global quotient because its projection kernel fixes those spaces. All boundary target fractions retain the original based real circle angle. Arbitrary infinite accumulation of the newly added closures still requires uniform control; C12 remains Open.
